top_signals.title: Trafigura Not Rushing to Alternative Marine Fuels
top_signals.summary: Shipowners have been ordering vessels capable of burning alternative fuels, but Trafigura’s marine fuel business isn't seeing enough demand for those fuels to justify major new investments. The ships may have different engines, but much of the fuel going into them hasn't changed. “We will not make any big alternative-fuel investments until there's demand,” Kenneth Dam, executive director of TFG Marine, told Reuters at a conference in Geneva on Thursday.
